people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

translations.web: As for Ephraim, their glory will fly away like a bird. There will be no birth, no one with child, and no conception.
translations.bsb: Ephraim’s glory will fly away like a bird, with no birth, no pregnancy, and no conception.
translations.kjv: As for Ephraim, their glory shall fly away like a bird, from the birth, and from the womb, and from the conception.
translations.asv: As for Ephraim, their glory shall fly away like a bird: there shall be no birth, and none with child, and no conception.
